title: fraxinus excelsior subsp. rostrata
intro: Fraxinus excelsior subsp. rostrata, commonly known as European aspen, is a subspecies of the common ash tree, native to Northern Europe and Northern Asia. This tree is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing stress and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of European aspen are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which work to modulate the immune system and reduce inflammation. Furthermore, the saponins present in European aspen have been found to exhibit antiviral and antibacterial properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various infections.
